place.name: Rio Grande Gorge Bridge
place.description: The Rio Grande Gorge Bridge, locally known as the "Gorge Bridge" or the "Taos High Bridge", is a steel deck arch bridge across the Rio Grande Gorge 10 miles (16 km) northwest of Taos, New Mexico, United States. Roughly 600 feet (180 m) above the Rio Grande, it is the seventh highest bridge in the United States.
